citation.title: Assessment of Forces in Intradermal Injection Devices: Hydrodynamic Versus Human Factors
citation.authors: Verwulgen S, Beyers K, Van Mulder T, Peeters T, Truijen S, Dams F, Vankerckhoven V

needles_table_i_measured.notes: Used for glycerol viscosity series; Table III lists d_n=0.130 mm L=18.5 mm for regression

glycerol_force_availability: Fig. 6 scatter only; slope 0.78 intercept 0.10 N R2 99.7% vs model — absolute F_exp-F_fric not tabulated; cannot build panel rows without digitizing/inventing

water_overall_regression.note: Regression against their model F_s, not a raw data table for OpenInjectability panel import

how_to_use: Replicate geometry (barrel 4.67 mm ID, needle #14 or other measured IDs) on a load cell.
Subtract empty-syringe friction at the same plunger speed (Table II).
Record measured_fluid_force_n = F_total - F_friction with force_definition fluid_only.
Fill validation/experimental/panel_*.json from panel.template.json and run: openinjectability validate-experimental ...
